title: INTELLECT-3: Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 关注开放 RL 基础设施、环境反馈、异步训练和数据可复现性的研究者
one_line: Prime Intellect reports SFT and asynchronous RL of a 106B MoE on released verifier-backed environments, with open infrastructure but no frozen run-level data manifest.
Prime Intellect 披露了 106B MoE 的 SFT 与大规模异步 RL 基础设施和环境，但未提供冻结的运行级数据清单。
why: It lets reviewers separate genuinely open RL infrastructure and environments from undisclosed mixture weights, rollout settings, and record-level lineage.
inclusion_reason: A frontier report with unusually broad infrastructure disclosure for SFT and large-scale verifier-backed RL, while still leaving run-level data mixture and rollout manifests unresolved.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports often call a training stack open even when the exact prompts, environment mixture, rollout settings, and record-level lineage are not reproducible. INTELLECT-3 is useful for testing this distinction because Prime Intellect releases the model, trainer, verifier framework, and environments while reporting a large SFT-plus-RL run.

The audit question is therefore not only how well the model performs, but which post-training data and feedback interfaces are concretely reusable and which run-level details remain undisclosed.

前沿模型报告经常把训练栈称为“开放”，但精确提示、环境混合、rollout 设置和记录级谱系仍不可复现。INTELLECT-3 适合检验这种区别，因为 Prime Intellect 在报告大规模 SFT 与 RL 训练的同时，发布了模型、训练器、verifier 框架和环境。

因此，审计问题不仅是模型表现如何，还包括哪些后训练数据与反馈接口确实可复用，以及哪些运行级细节仍未披露。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
INTELLECT-3 is a 106B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 12B active parameters, post-trained from GLM-4.5-Air-Base by supervised fine-tuning followed by large-scale asynchronous reinforcement learning. The reusable data object is an environment episode: prompt, model reasoning and actions, tool or sandbox observations, and an environment-defined reward or terminal outcome.

Prime Intellect connects these episodes through prime-rl, the verifiers library, the Environments Hub, and Prime Sandboxes. The report is consequently both a model report and a partial disclosure ledger for an open environment-based RL stack.

INTELLECT-3 是一个总参数 106B、激活参数 12B 的 MoE 模型，以 GLM-4.5-Air-Base 为基础，先做监督微调，再进行大规模异步强化学习。其可复用数据对象是环境 episode：提示、模型推理与动作、工具或沙箱观察，以及环境定义的奖励或终止结果。

Prime Intellect 通过 prime-rl、verifiers 库、Environments Hub 和 Prime Sandboxes 串联这些 episode。因此，该报告既是模型报告，也是开放环境式 RL 栈的一份部分披露账本。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training has two main stages: SFT and asynchronous RL. The RL mixture spans math, code, science, logic, deep research, and software engineering. prime-rl runs policy actors and training asynchronously, so rollouts may be slightly off-policy. Environments use the verifiers interface, and agentic code tasks can execute in isolated Prime Sandboxes.

The full effort used 512 NVIDIA H200 GPUs across 64 nodes over roughly two months. The official release exposes the model, trainer, verifier framework, and environment ecosystem, but does not pin one immutable manifest containing every prompt, environment version, mixture weight, decoding parameter, and rollout record from the reported run.

训练包含两个主要阶段：SFT 和异步 RL。RL 混合覆盖数学、代码、科学、逻辑、深度研究和软件工程。prime-rl 异步运行策略 actor 与训练，因此 rollout 可能略微 off-policy。环境采用 verifiers 接口，智能体代码任务可在隔离的 Prime Sandboxes 中执行。

完整训练约使用 64 个节点上的 512 张 NVIDIA H200，持续约两个月。官方发布公开了模型、训练器、verifier 框架和环境生态，但没有固定一份不可变清单，列出报告运行中的全部提示、环境版本、混合权重、解码参数和 rollout 记录。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official model card reports INTELLECT-3 scores of 98.1 on MATH-500, 90.8 on AIME24, 88.0 on AIME25, 69.3 on LiveCodeBench, 74.4 on GPQA, 14.6 on HLE, and 81.9 on MMLU-Pro. These results support improvement over the GLM-4.5-Air base in the evaluated settings.

The official release also provides the model weights, prime-rl, verifiers, and environment access. This supports claims about artifact availability, but it does not prove that an independent user can exactly reconstruct the original training mixture or reproduce the full run without the missing frozen manifests and settings.

官方模型卡报告 INTELLECT-3 在 MATH-500、AIME24、AIME25、LiveCodeBench、GPQA、HLE 和 MMLU-Pro 上分别取得 98.1、90.8、88.0、69.3、74.4、14.6 和 81.9。这些结果支持其在相应评测设置下相对 GLM-4.5-Air 基座有所提升。

官方还发布了模型权重、prime-rl、verifiers 和环境入口。这能支持“artifact 可获得”的说法，但在缺少冻结清单和设置时，不能证明独立使用者能够精确重建原始训练混合或复现完整运行。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinguishing contribution is the integration of a 100B-plus MoE post-training run with an openly released asynchronous RL trainer, a modular verifier/environment interface, a community environment hub, and high-throughput sandbox execution. The report treats environments as separately versionable training and evaluation artifacts rather than embedding all task logic inside one trainer repository.

This openness is broader than a weights-only model release, but it should not be confused with releasing the exact generated rollout corpus or an immutable run manifest.

其区别性贡献是把 100B 以上 MoE 的后训练运行，与公开的异步 RL 训练器、模块化 verifier/环境接口、社区环境中心以及高吞吐沙箱执行整合起来。报告把环境视为可独立版本化的训练与评估 artifact，而不是把所有任务逻辑嵌入单一训练仓库。

这种开放程度超过仅发布权重的模型，但不能与“发布精确生成的 rollout 语料或不可变运行清单”混为一谈。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The exact SFT sources, per-environment RL mixture weights, prompt manifests, rollout counts, decoding settings, and run-time environment revisions are not fully disclosed in one frozen artifact. Decontamination procedures are also unclear. Asynchronous updates introduce policy lag, while environment-specific rewards remain vulnerable to incomplete tests, brittle parsers, or reward hacking.

Open-source infrastructure lowers reproduction barriers but does not eliminate the compute requirement or guarantee that mutable Hub environments match the versions used in the original run.

精确的 SFT 来源、各环境 RL 混合权重、提示清单、rollout 数量、解码设置和运行时环境版本，没有集中披露在一份冻结 artifact 中；去污染流程也不清楚。异步更新会引入策略滞后，而环境特定奖励仍可能受到测试不完整、解析器脆弱或 reward hacking 的影响。

开源基础设施降低了复现门槛，但不能消除算力需求，也不能保证持续变化的 Hub 环境与原始运行所用版本一致。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For post-training research, this work offers concrete interfaces for packaging verifier-backed environments, running multi-turn and tool-using rollouts, and scaling asynchronous RL. It is useful as an implementation reference for separating task environments from trainer code and for comparing environmental feedback contracts across domains.

For audit work, the report is a strong example of why artifact openness and run reproducibility must be scored separately: the stack is reusable, while the precise data mixture and record-level lineage remain incomplete.

对于后训练研究，该工作提供了封装 verifier-backed 环境、运行多轮与工具调用 rollout、以及扩展异步 RL 的具体接口。它可作为将任务环境与训练器代码分离、并跨领域比较环境反馈契约的实现参考。

对于审计工作，该报告清楚说明为什么必须分别评价 artifact 开放度与运行可复现性：训练栈可复用，但精确数据混合和记录级谱系仍不完整。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate released infrastructure from the unreleased frozen rollout corpus and run manifest.
  • Check the exact version and reward logic of every Environments Hub module before reuse.
  • Treat benchmark gains as evidence for the reported evaluation settings, not proof of complete recipe reproducibility.
  • Audit asynchronous policy lag, sandbox behavior, test coverage, and reward-gaming surfaces together.

• 区分已发布基础设施与未发布的冻结 rollout 语料和运行清单。
  • 复用前核对每个 Environments Hub 模块的精确版本和奖励逻辑。
  • 将基准提升视为报告评测设置下的证据，而不是完整配方可复现的证明。
  • 联合审计异步策略滞后、沙箱行为、测试覆盖率和 reward-gaming 攻击面。
